reference_node_ids.description: Node ids of the reference implementation group (e.g. the Haskell cardano-node relays).

target_node_ids.description: Node ids of the target implementation group (e.g. the Amaru relays).

tolerance_slots.description: Allowed slot gap between the two groups' converged tips. 0 requires hash-identical tips; >0 permits agreement modulo lag (reported as within_slot_tolerance).

require_real_progress.description: Require both groups' tips to show real non-zero chain progress, so the assertion cannot pass on nodes stalled at genesis.
